hero_sub: Palmetto Masters — Mt. Pleasant & North Charleston, South Carolina
hero_tagline: A US Masters Swimming club for the Charleston area
about_text: Palmetto Masters is a US Masters Swimming club serving the Charleston area, with coached practices in Mt. Pleasant and North Charleston, South Carolina. It is one of the largest Masters teams in the state, with more than 25 coached practices a week.
about_text_2: Members range from fitness swimmers and triathletes to nationally competitive athletes across all age groups. Whether you're returning to the pool after years away or training for your next championship meet, there's a lane for you.
about_text_3: USMS membership (or a 30-day trial membership) is required to swim with the team.
schedule_note: USMS membership (or a 30-day trial membership) is required to swim with the team. Contact the club for current practice times.
